english.note: Use this when referring to material intended to be read rather than the activity of reading.
Use this for something such as a book or magazine taken or used for reading.

examples.english: This is reading material for children.
examples.traditional: 呢本係畀小朋友睇嘅讀物。
examples.jyutping: ni1 bun2 hai6 bei2 siu2 pang4 jau5 tai2 ge3 duk6 mat6

examples.english: This magazine is reading matter for my train rides.
examples.traditional: 呢本雜誌係我搭車時嘅讀物。
examples.jyutping: nei1 bun2 zaap6 zi3 hai6 ngo5 daap3 ce1 si4 ge3 duk6 mat6
